description: Clone an existing dashboard into a new dashboard owned by the caller. The copy keeps the source's widgets (same widget ids), sections, filters, and viewer settings, gets a "<name> (copy)" title, has no shared users and no public link, and starts at revision 0. Edit it afterwards with update_dashboard.
